name: inspira-sparkles

frames.best_why: A dense drift of white dots across the top band is clearest here, with the heading above.

tagline: White specks drift and twinkle over a dark backdrop.
summary: A canvas field of small white dots scattered over a black surface. They float gently and fade in and out, densest at the top and thinning downward, like slow falling snow or stars.
appearance: Hundreds of tiny white dots are scattered across a near-black backdrop, each a slightly different size and brightness. They are heaviest in the upper band and thin out toward the bottom, giving a soft fade. A large white headline sits above them in the demo.
behaviour: Each dot drifts on a slow diagonal velocity and wraps around the edges when it leaves, so the field never empties. A per-dot sine phase makes them pulse dimmer and brighter, producing a gentle twinkle.
demo_content: A large white heading reading Inspira UI above two faint blue gradient lines and the particle field.
search_phrases: snowy particle field for a hero
use_when: A dark hero or full-bleed section that needs quiet motion behind a headline without stealing attention.
avoid_when: Runs a canvas loop forever with no reduced-motion pause, and the default background is a hardcoded blue.
customise: Set the background colour, particle colour, count, size range and speed through props; the drift physics and twinkle are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A requestAnimationFrame canvas redraws every dot each frame; the demo runs 900 particles.

a11y.note: Decorative background with no prefers-reduced-motion check, so the endless drift keeps animating for motion-sensitive users.

polish_why: Tidy drifting field with soft fade; the effect is familiar and the dots very slight.
title: Sparkles
